title: Jab Chaand Muharram ka Aata Hai Nazar Logon
body:
Zara Socha Karo Kis Tara Ujra Ho Ga Khatoon Ka Ghar Logon
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Chaand Me Ujri Hai Beemar Ki Ummeedein
Dukhia Ne Guzri Hai, Rotay Huey Do Eidein
Phir Bhi Na Milli Karbala Se Aanay Ki, Akbar Ki Khabar Logon
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Chaand To Chamka Hai Aflaak Ke Seeney Pe
Zahra Ka Chaand Chupa Hai, Haye Khak Ke Seeney Main
Khoon May Nehladiya Teeron Aur Talwaron Se, Haider Ka Pisar Logon
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Ki Azaan Aisay Goonji Hay Zamanay May
Nabiyown Ne Suni Aake Karbal Kay Veeranay May
Laila Kay Chaand Ka Cheer Dala Hay Paal May Barchi Ne Jigar Logon
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra Kay Bharay Ghar Ko Ummat Ne Rulaya Hai
Shabbir Ki Gardan Pe Khanjar Bhi Chalaya Hai
Mustafa Ko Diya Kalma Parnay Walon Ne Kya Khoob Ajar Logon
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Bhi Chaleen Ghar Se Ghazi Ke Saharay Pe
Sojaye Ga Jo Ja Kar Darya Ke Kinaray Pe
Aur Nabi Zadiyan Sar Barehna Jayengi Karnay Ko Safar Logon
